variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, medium height, extra long slender grain variety grown extensively in north India. Developed by PAU and released in 2015. Highly adapted to irrigated lowlands. This variety is beneficial to the farmers on account of its high yield, high HRR and grain weight, suitable growth duration and better disease resistance. Excellent grain quality characteristics.
